why: There are three patterns: lines branching upward (like a V), straight flat lines, and lines branching downward (like a fir tree). Every row has each pattern once. Row 3 has flat lines and the fir-tree pattern, so the missing one is the V pattern, option 1. Option 3 is the fir tree again.
trick: Look carefully at the direction of the branches - up-branches and down-branches are different figures.
